correctness.rationale: The negative-square identity forces singular values a,rho^2/a, and the norm-maximizing vector yields a canonical orthonormal pair. Exact parametrization y=conjugate(q)x+k e^{i phi}v reduces all possible moduli to a continuous one-parameter family; the maximum/minimum are sharp support-function extrema. Rotational symmetry and connectedness yield the complete annulus; all endpoints are treated. The bundled finite checker corroborates the canonical relations and sharpness but is not substituted for proof.

Targeted published mathematical-record and bibliographic searches found no equivalent identified claim. value.rationale: The intrinsic negative-square class generalizes quaternionic antiunitary structures by allowing arbitrary singular-value anisotropy. Its complete q-range classification and sharp nontrivial annulus-to-disk phase boundary supply an exact invariant beyond qualitative annularity, with explicit realization of every distortion, all endpoints, and a transparent 4:1 example. This is a natural model class with structural content, not a single arbitrary parameter computation.
